Prior research recovered from data/careers/supplements.json in the existing parliament-experience checkout. Its user-supplied LinkedIn screenshot transcription (10 September 2026) is preserved as inherited evidence, not independently re-viewed in this batch. Dates require confirmation against the original profile/screenshot before headline use.
Public appointment reporting states Fujitsu commencement February 2023, whereas inherited profile transcription says January 2023; retained as unresolved conflict, not silently reconciled.

The current codebook excludes employer associations and political staff. Older supplement sector labels were recoded accordingly. Board/advisory posts are retained but not treated as full-time employment.
Public LinkedIn departure post confirms leaving Fujitsu about two years after joining but renders only a relative timestamp; no exact date inferred from it.
